title: Change shape: Wan VACE (extend)
description: A video in a new shape with the new space filled in (outpainting): the video on its new canvas and a mask of where to fill. The studio makes both (film op outpaint_prep) and lays the original back over the result (outpaint_join).

labels.900:value: What the new space shows, around the video
labels.299:file: The video on its new canvas (grey where the new space goes)
labels.303:file: The mask (white where the new space goes)

hints: Made in parts of at most 5 seconds at 16 frames a second; the studio cuts the video into them and joins them again.
Say what is around the subject: the room, the street, the sky. With a static or slow camera it fills in best.
A small change of shape (16:9 to 4:5 or 1:1) looks better than a large one (16:9 to 9:16).
